children: NVIDIA (NVDA) guided fiscal 2028 for ~70% revenue growth, citing huge hyperscaler demand, new cloud partnerships and a roughly $35 billion cloud-computing agreement driving AI-accelerator sales.
NVIDIA (NVDA) is reportedly in late talks to buy AI startup Hugging Face for about $14B ( ~$12.9B upfront, ~$1B retention). Deal would add Hugging Face model platform to NVIDIA.
NVIDIA expanded its MediaTek deal: NVLink Fusion will let custom XPUs and AI chips link to NVIDIA rack-scale AI systems; MediaTek will handle connectivity, memory, manufacturing and packaging.
NVIDIA (NVDA) is entering custom AI chips with NVHBM: moving the memory controller to the base die, using NVIDIA die-to-die links instead of JEDEC, controlling the memory subsystem.
NVIDIA (NVDA) invested $3B in SB Energy: $1.5B via private placement of new Class N non-voting shares at IPO price and $1.5B through an earlier forward contract.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang flagged a cybersecurity inflection from agentic AI and autonomous attacks, noted SafeMind and Nemotron models for security, and supports a mix of closed and open models.
Nvidia (NVDA) fell ~1.4% after Texas paused new grid connections and separated real data‑center projects from paperwork, potentially delaying large-scale data‑center timelines and NVDA demand.
Jamendo served an amended complaint against NVIDIA (NVDA), adding details to its claims; the filing advances the legal case to the next procedural phase.
Analysts say NVIDIA’s space-computing deals with SpaceX unlikely to bring meaningful NVDA revenue before fiscal 2029, citing heat, radiation, satellite crowding and regulatory hurdles.
